wins: Maintained a stable reward of 60, indicating consistent action-value alignment despite failure to complete objectives.
Completed 10 mentor interactions, demonstrating willingness to iterate through guided correction and logging the steps.
fails: Zero percent success rate; the agent failed to reach the mission objective in the single episode despite accumulating reward.
Excessive reliance on mentor calls suggests gaps in autonomous decision-making under the current policy.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent shows disciplined reward generation but cannot translate it into task completion; needs focused refinement on autonomy without mentor dependency.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent stops short of objective every time mentor guidance is required, indicating misinterpretation of terminal criteria.

skill_cards.if_condition: When the reconnaissance phase yields high reward but the mission objective is unmet
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger a secondary validation loop to re-evaluate objective constraints and avoid premature termination

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor guidance is requested after every two actions
skill_cards.then_action: Introduce a self-assessment routine that simulates the next two actions mentally before executing

skill_cards.if_condition: When cumulative reward plateaus early in episode
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to a high-risk exploration mode that prioritizes alternative pathways toward objective completion

memory_ops.reason: High reward stability suggests conservation of reconnaissance insight is valuable for avoiding premature exits.

next_experiments.title: Introduce objective revalidation checkpoint
next_experiments.description: Insert a mid-episode checkpoint that reassesses objective status and prevents early termination once reward is stable.

next_experiments.title: Simulated action preview before mentor escalation
next_experiments.description: Before requesting mentor assistance, simulate two future steps to determine if guidance is warranted.

next_experiments.title: Exploration mode with alternative routes
